title: Reference 2: vendor certificate register — EDT, enum, table, SimpleList form, menu, security, form extension
prompt:
You are a Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations X++ developer. Work in the model `{{model}}`: its metadata folder is `{{modelDir}}` and its package descriptor is under `{{packageDir}}\Descriptor`. The standard application's metadata (ApplicationSuite, ApplicationPlatform, ApplicationFoundation, …) is under `{{packagesRoot}}` — read it, never change it. Extensions only, no overlayering. Every new object name starts with the prefix Mcp. Every user-facing text (labels, help texts, info/warning/error messages) is a label in the model's label file `{{model}}`, never a hardcoded string. Never use today(); use DateTimeUtil::getToday(DateTimeUtil::getUserPreferredTimeZone()).

Business requirement: procurement wants to register the quality certificates of each vendor (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, food safety, …) with their validity, and open them straight from the vendor.

Implement:
1. A string EDT McpVendCertificateId (size 20) and an extensible enum McpVendCertificateType with the values Iso9001, Iso14001, FoodSafety and Other.
2. A new table McpVendCertificate with the fields VendAccount (EDT VendAccount, mandatory), CertificateId (McpVendCertificateId, mandatory), CertificateType (McpVendCertificateType), ValidFrom and ValidTo (EDT TransDate) and Description (EDT Description). Give it a unique index on VendAccount + CertificateId used as the primary and clustered index, a foreign-key relation to VendTable on VendAccount, title fields, an Overview field group with all fields, static find() and exist() methods by VendAccount + CertificateId, and a validateWrite() that rejects a ValidTo earlier than ValidFrom with a label error.
3. A form McpVendCertificate that follows the SimpleList form pattern, with a grid over the Overview field group.
4. A display menu item McpVendCertificate that opens the form, added through a menu extension to the standard Procurement and sourcing module menu (ProcurementAndSourcing).
5. Two security privileges on that menu item: McpVendCertificateMaintain (delete access) and McpVendCertificateView (read access).
6. A form extension of the standard vendor details form VendTable with an action pane button that opens McpVendCertificate filtered on the current vendor.

The model must build (xppc full build) with zero errors. To build it, run exactly `{{buildCommand}}` in the shell — it compiles the labels and the model and prints every error. When you are done, reply with the list of objects you created or changed, one line each.

files.name: table: fields, primary index, VendTable relation, find/exist/validateWrite
VendTable form extension opens the register
labels added to the model's label file

notes: Reference use-case 2 of 3 — 'new master data'. The full vertical slice every new setup/master table gets: data model, a form on a standard pattern, navigation, security, and the entry point from the standard record it belongs to. Grounding the MCP server should supply: the SimpleList pattern's required control tree, the ProcurementAndSourcing menu's structure, the VendTable form's action pane, the AxSecurityPrivilege shape.
